title: Bahmani Kingdom & Deccan Sultanates
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🏰 Bahmani Kingdom & Deccan Sultanates
blocks.intro: The major Islamic state of Deccan, which continuously warred with Vijayanagara over the fertile Raichur Doab.

blocks.heading: 1. Bahmani Kingdom (1347 - 1527)
bullets: Founded in 1347 by **Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah** (also known as Hasan Gangu) in revolt against Muhammad bin Tughlaq.
Capital was initially Gulbarga, later shifted to Bidar. Mahmud Gawan (great prime minister) expanded power via administrative reforms.

blocks.heading: 2. Split into Deccan Sultanates
blocks.intro: In the early 16th century, the Bahmani kingdom disintegrated into five independent sultanates:
bullets: Adil Shahis of Bijapur: Founded by Yusuf Adil Shah. Famous for building the **Gol Gumbaz** (largest dome in India, featuring a whispering gallery).
Nizam Shahis of Ahmadnagar: Malik Ahmad. Defended by Chand Bibi against Akbar's forces.
Qutb Shahis of Golconda: Quli Qutb Shah. Famous for Golconda Diamond mines. Built **Charminar** in Hyderabad.
Imad Shahis of Berar: Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk.
Barid Shahis of Bidar: Qasim Barid.

formulas: Bahmani: Hasan Gangu (1347) | Gol Gumbaz: Bijapur (Adil Shah) | Charminar: Golconda
